title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on paired mirror-framed moral scenarios (an action frame and an omission frame) to measure the rate at which they recommend agent-level inaction in both frames despite opposite substantive outcomes.
Evaluating models on paired mirror-framed moral scenarios to measure the rate at which they recommend agent-level action in both frames despite opposite substantive outcomes.
